steps.summary: Re-ran the engine on the watchlist, compared with git d87dce4^: 3 lots changed.

For 324 Curtin Ave, the verdict changed from "not checked yet: its rules are proposed by the model, awaiting a person" to "too narrow: 22 − 15 − 5 = 2 ft, for a 16 ft two-unit house" because the rules changed from 2 signed by a person, 6 in pencil (proposed by the model, not checked) to 8 signed by a person; signed by Sin (Student, team 24×100).
Drafted the next move for 324 Curtin Ave: an inquiry to City Real Estate (send gate).

For lot 503 Climax St, the verdict went from not checked yet: its rules are proposed by the model, awaiting a person to too narrow: 25 − 5 − 5 = 15 ft, for a 16 ft two-unit house because the rules changed from 2 signed by a person, 6 in pencil (proposed by the model, not checked) to 8 signed by a person; signed by Sin (Student, team 24×100).
Drafted the next move for 503 Climax St: an inquiry to City Real Estate (send gate).

For 507 Climax St, the map verdict went from not checked yet: its rules are proposed by the model, awaiting a person to too narrow: 25 − 5 − 5 = 15 ft, for a 16 ft two-unit house because the rules changed from 2 signed by a person, 6 in pencil (proposed by the model, not checked) to 8 signed by a person; signed by Sin (Student, team 24'times100).
Drafted the next move for 507 Climax St: an inquiry to City Real Estate (send gate).

SIMULATION, not a record: if lot 24 got a building permit, 2241 Mahon St (lot 25)'s side facing it could take the contextual setback (§925.06.C, not below 3 ft): at best 24 − 3 − 10 = 11 ft, against a 16 ft two-unit house. Today it is 24 − 10 − 10 = 4 ft. Pencil: it depends on the new building's actual setback.
Verified: 40 numbers traced to the engine, no name-like field.
Waiting on a person: 3 letters to send. Nothing is sent without a person.

drafts.to: City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh
drafts.subject: Inquiry to Buy City-Owned Vacant Lot at 324 Curtin Ave
drafts.text: Dear City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh, This is an inquiry, not an offer, regarding the City-owned vacant lot at 324 Curtin Ave in Beltzhoover. The zoning district is R2-H and the City sale status is Available for Sale as of 2016-11-17. We are interested in buying this lot for a small home. Could you please provide information on the price and the process for acquisition? Sincerely, The 24x100 user

drafts.to: City Real Estate, City of Pittsburgh
drafts.subject: Inquiry about 503 Climax St
drafts.text: Dear City Real Estate, I am writing to make an inquiry about buying the City-owned vacant lot at 503 Climax St in Beltzhoover. This lot is zoned R2-H and its City sale status is Available for Sale, as of 2026-08-05. Please note that this is strictly an inquiry, not an offer. Could you please provide information regarding the price and the process for purchasing this property? Sincerely, The 24x100 user
